title: The Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
summary: A twelve-year-old with dyslexia and ADHD is accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt and learns he is the son of a Greek god. With two friends he sets out across the United States to clear his name and prevent a war among the gods.
readIf: you want a quick, jokey, myth-filled adventure with a snarky narrator and a cross-country quest.
skipIf: you want serious, deeply drawn characters, as this is breezy and aimed at younger readers.

pairings.reason: Another young hero who learns he belongs to a hidden magical world, with humour and friends.
A shorter, older portal adventure where siblings are swept into a world of talking animals and myth.
A grown-up, lyrical look at Greek myth for those who want the same material told more seriously.
